blocks.zh: 簡介與沖洗製程
blocks.en: Introduction and the Rinsing Process

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解沖洗除熱原（Depyrogenation by Rinsing）的適用場景：何種材料無法使用乾熱，只能採用沖洗法
blocks.en: Understand when depyrogenation by rinsing applies: which materials cannot tolerate dry heat and can only be depyrogenated by rinsing

blocks.zh: 掌握 Water for Injection (WFI，注射用水) 在沖洗除熱原中的核心角色及其品質要求（<0.25 EU/mL）
blocks.en: Understand the central role of Water for Injection (WFI) in depyrogenation by rinsing and its quality requirement (<0.25 EU/mL)

blocks.zh: 了解沖洗水的溫度管理——「危險溫度帶」（8°–55°）對沖洗製程設計的重要意涵
blocks.en: Understand rinse water temperature management, in particular the "danger zone" (8°–55°), and what it means for rinsing process design

blocks.zh: 識別再熱原化（Re-pyrogenation）的風險及其預防策略
blocks.en: Recognize the risk of re-pyrogenation and the strategies to prevent it

blocks.zh: 熟悉 USP 規定的五項關鍵製程參數，能夠在驗證計畫書（Validation Protocol）中正確呈現
blocks.en: Know the five critical process parameters specified by USP and be able to present them correctly in a validation protocol

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — 為什麼需要沖洗除熱原？
blocks.en: Core Concepts: Why Is Depyrogenation by Rinsing Needed?

blocks.zh: 兩大除熱原策略：
blocks.en: Two depyrogenation strategies:

blocks.zh: 破壞（Destruction）：乾熱除熱原（如 250°C / 30 min），適用於耐熱物品（玻璃注射瓶、鋁蓋）——LPS 在高溫下水解失活
blocks.en: Destruction: dry heat depyrogenation (e.g., 250°C / 30 min) for heat-resistant items (glass vials, aluminum caps); LPS is hydrolyzed and inactivated at high temperature

blocks.zh: 移除（Removal）：沖洗除熱原，適用於熱敏感（heat-labile）材料，如橡膠塞（elastomeric stoppers）、某些塑膠製品、醫療器材
blocks.en: Removal: depyrogenation by rinsing, used for heat-labile materials such as elastomeric stoppers, certain plastic components and medical devices

blocks.zh: Heat-labile（熱不穩定）：在高溫（如 250°C 乾熱）下會變形、降解或功能喪失的材料。橡膠塞就是最典型的例子——它無法承受乾熱處理，因此沖洗是其除熱原的唯一可行物理方式。
blocks.en: Heat-labile: materials that deform, degrade or lose function at high temperature (e.g., 250°C dry heat). Elastomeric stoppers are the classic example: they cannot withstand dry heat, so rinsing is the only practical physical means of depyrogenating them.

blocks.zh: 關鍵定位：〈1228.4〉 聚焦在「移除」的機制，核心策略是「沖走 + 稀釋」而非「摧毀」。
blocks.en: Key positioning: <1228.4> focuses on the mechanism of "removal"; the core strategy is "wash away + dilute", not "destroy".

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — 乾熱 vs. 沖洗
blocks.en: Analogy: Dry Heat vs. Rinsing

blocks.zh: 想像你的餐具上有有害物質（內毒素）：
blocks.en: Imagine your tableware is covered in a harmful substance (endotoxin):

blocks.zh: 乾熱除熱原就像把餐具放進烤箱——高溫直接摧毀污染物。適合陶瓷和金屬（玻璃瓶、鋁箔），但塑膠餐具（橡膠塞）放進烤箱會融化。
blocks.en: Dry heat depyrogenation is like putting the tableware in an oven: high heat destroys the contaminant directly. It suits ceramics and metal (glass vials, aluminum foil), but plastic tableware (rubber stoppers) would melt in the oven.

blocks.zh: 沖洗除熱原就像用大量流動熱水沖洗餐具——不破壞餐具，但把污染物沖走稀釋掉。
blocks.en: Depyrogenation by rinsing is like rinsing the tableware with a large flow of hot water: the tableware is not damaged, but the contaminant is washed away and diluted.

blocks.zh: 沖洗法的挑戰在於：你需要確保「沖洗水本身」是乾淨的，否則用髒水沖洗只是把污染物換一種形式留在餐具上。
blocks.en: The challenge with rinsing is that you must make sure the rinse water itself is clean; otherwise, rinsing with dirty water simply leaves the contaminant on the tableware in a different form.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 〈1228.4〉 的定位
blocks.en: Key Point: The Role of <1228.4>

blocks.zh: 沖洗除熱原是橡膠塞、塑膠器材、醫療器材等熱敏感物品的標準除熱原方法，在無菌充填廠房中極為普遍。
blocks.en: Depyrogenation by rinsing is the standard depyrogenation method for heat-sensitive items such as rubber stoppers, plastic components and medical devices, and it is very common in sterile filling facilities.

blocks.zh: CDMO 的無菌製程中，幾乎所有橡膠塞在使用前都必須經過清洗（Washing）和除熱原處理——而沖洗是這個步驟的法規依據之一。
blocks.en: In a CDMO's aseptic process, almost every rubber stopper must be washed and depyrogenated before use, and rinsing is one of the regulatory bases for that step.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 為什麼橡膠塞不能使用乾熱除熱原？在無菌充填廠的日常生產中，橡膠塞的除熱原通常如何整合到塞子清洗流程中？
blocks.en: Why can't rubber stoppers be depyrogenated by dry heat? In day-to-day production at a sterile filling site, how is stopper depyrogenation usually integrated into the stopper washing process?

blocks.zh: 〈1228.4〉 使用「destruction or removal」這個措辭。沖洗法屬於哪一類？這對如何設計驗證研究有什麼影響？
blocks.en: <1228.4> uses the wording "destruction or removal". Which category does rinsing fall into, and how does this affect the design of validation studies?

blocks.zh: Rinsing Process | 沖洗製程
blocks.en: Rinsing Process

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — 沖洗機制與 WFI 品質要求
blocks.en: Core Concepts: Rinsing Mechanism and WFI Quality Requirements

blocks.zh: 沖洗除熱原的機制：物理移除（removal） + 稀釋（dilution）。不同於乾熱的化學破壞，沖洗只是把表面的 LPS 帶走——因此沖洗水的品質和沖洗次數直接決定最終的殘餘內毒素水平。
blocks.en: Mechanism of depyrogenation by rinsing: physical removal + dilution. Unlike the chemical destruction achieved by dry heat, rinsing simply carries surface LPS away, so the quality of the rinse water and the number of rinses directly determine the final residual endotoxin level.

blocks.zh: WFI（Water for Injection，注射用水）品質要求：
blocks.en: WFI (Water for Injection) quality requirements:

blocks.zh: 細菌內毒素限度：<0.25 EU/mL（USP 〈661〉 Water for Injection 規格）
blocks.en: Bacterial endotoxin limit: <0.25 EU/mL (USP <661> Water for Injection specification)

blocks.zh: 建議沖洗溫度：>60°C（抑制微生物生長）
blocks.en: Recommended rinse temperature: >60°C (to suppress microbial growth)

blocks.zh: USP 建議將 WFI 循環系統維持在 ≥70°C 或冷藏（≤8°C），避開微生物快速增殖的「危險溫度帶」
blocks.en: USP recommends keeping WFI circulation systems at ≥70°C or refrigerated (≤8°C), avoiding the "danger zone" in which microorganisms multiply rapidly

blocks.zh: Re-pyrogenation（再熱原化）：若沖洗水本身含有革蘭氏陰性菌，細菌死亡後釋出 LPS，反而將內毒素沉積到已清潔的物品表面，導致除熱原失敗。這是沖洗法最隱性的失效模式。
blocks.en: Re-pyrogenation: if the rinse water itself contains Gram-negative bacteria, LPS is released when the bacteria die and is deposited onto the already cleaned items, causing depyrogenation to fail. This is the most hidden failure mode of rinsing.

blocks.zh: WFI 溫度管理 — 危險帶公式
blocks.en: WFI Temperature Management: The Danger Zone

blocks.zh:
WFI 安全溫度區間：
  熱循環：   ≥ 70°C（USP 推薦）/ ≥ 60°C（操作最低）
  冷藏：     ≤ 8°C（需滅菌並保存於無菌容器）

危險溫度帶（微生物快速增殖）：
  8°C ＜ T ＜ 55°C

危險帶內最大持水時間：
  ≤ 3–4 小時

→ 超過此時間的 WFI 不應用於除熱原沖洗
  （除非已滅菌並保存於無菌密閉容器中）

WFI 內毒素限度：
  < 0.25 EU/mL（USP 最低要求）
  實際生產控制目標通常更嚴格（如 <0.1 EU/mL）
blocks.en:
WFI safe temperature ranges:
  Hot circulation:   ≥ 70°C (USP recommended) / ≥ 60°C (operating minimum)
  Refrigerated:      ≤ 8°C (must be sterilized and held in sterile containers)

Danger zone (rapid microbial growth):
  8°C < T < 55°C

Maximum water hold time within the danger zone:
  ≤ 3–4 hours

→ WFI held longer than this should not be used for depyrogenation rinsing
  (unless it has been sterilized and stored in sterile, closed containers)

WFI endotoxin limit:
  < 0.25 EU/mL (USP minimum requirement)
  Actual production control targets are usually tighter (e.g., <0.1 EU/mL)

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 沖洗水溫度管理是關鍵控制點
blocks.en: Key Point: Rinse Water Temperature Management Is a Critical Control Point

blocks.zh: 「只要用了 WFI 就夠了」是 CDMO 工廠最常見的誤解之一。USP 的核心警告是：
blocks.en: "Using WFI is enough" is one of the most common misconceptions in CDMO facilities. The core warning from USP is:

blocks.zh: WFI 的起始品質不保證過程中的品質維持。
blocks.en: The starting quality of WFI does not guarantee that quality is maintained during the process.

blocks.zh: 具體風險場景：
blocks.en: A typical risk scenario:

blocks.zh: WFI 從 80°C 循環管路取出後，在室溫環境中使用，溫度很快降至 30–40°C
blocks.en: WFI drawn from an 80°C circulation loop and used at room temperature quickly cools to 30–40°C

blocks.zh: 在這個溫度下若靜置超過 3–4 小時，革蘭氏陰性菌可快速增殖
blocks.en: If it sits at this temperature for more than 3–4 hours, Gram-negative bacteria can multiply rapidly

blocks.zh: 用這種受汙染的 WFI 沖洗橡膠塞，結果是「再熱原化」——把新的內毒素帶到塞子上
blocks.en: Rinsing rubber stoppers with this contaminated WFI results in "re-pyrogenation": new endotoxin is carried onto the stoppers

blocks.zh: CDMO 的解決方案：設計沖洗機（Washer）的用水回路時，確保 WFI 在整個沖洗流程中維持 ≥60°C，或取用後立即使用。
blocks.en: CDMO solution: when designing the water circuit of the washer, make sure WFI stays at ≥60°C throughout the rinsing process, or is used immediately after being drawn.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — WFI 溫度危險帶
blocks.en: Analogy: The WFI Temperature Danger Zone

blocks.zh: WFI 的溫度管理就像烹飪食品安全的「危險溫度帶」概念：
blocks.en: WFI temperature management is like the "danger zone" concept in food safety:

blocks.zh: 食品安全規範要求熟食不能在 4°C–60°C 之間存放超過 2 小時，因為細菌在這個溫度範圍內指數增殖。
blocks.en: Food safety rules say cooked food must not be kept between 4°C and 60°C for more than 2 hours, because bacteria multiply exponentially in this range.

blocks.zh: WFI 的道理完全相同：8°C–55°C 是微生物的「溫暖舒適區」。你可以把 WFI 想像成一鍋熱湯——要麼保持滾熱（≥60°C），要麼馬上冷藏（≤8°C），中間那個溫度是最危險的。
blocks.en: The same logic applies to WFI: 8°C–55°C is the microorganisms' "warm comfort zone". Think of WFI as a pot of hot soup: either keep it piping hot (≥60°C) or refrigerate it right away (≤8°C); the temperatures in between are the most dangerous.

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — 五項關鍵製程參數（CPP）
blocks.en: Core Concepts: The Five Critical Process Parameters (CPPs)

blocks.zh: USP 〈1228.4〉 列出的五項必須在驗證中定義和控制的關鍵因素，對應到製程驗證框架中的 Critical Process Parameters (CPP，關鍵製程參數)：
blocks.en: The five key factors that USP <1228.4> says must be defined and controlled in validation correspond to Critical Process Parameters (CPPs) in the process validation framework:

blocks.zh: 溶劑描述（Solvent Description）：WFI 的來源、水質標準；若用苛性鹼或清潔劑，必須明確濃度
blocks.en: Solvent Description: source of the WFI and water quality standard; if caustic or detergent is used, its concentration must be specified

blocks.zh: 溶劑溫度（Solvent Temperature）：直接影響除熱原效果和微生物控制；建議 ≥60°C
blocks.en: Solvent Temperature: directly affects depyrogenation effectiveness and microbial control; ≥60°C is recommended

blocks.zh: 溶劑壓力（Solvent Pressure）：對靜置沖洗的玻璃器皿或設備尤其重要，壓力決定水流能否到達所有接觸面
blocks.en: Solvent Pressure: especially important for static-rinsed glassware or equipment, where pressure determines whether the water reaches all contact surfaces

blocks.zh: 溶劑流速（Flow Rate）：影響沖洗停留時間和機械沖刷力，與 LRV 直接相關
blocks.en: Flow Rate: affects rinse contact time and mechanical scrubbing action, and is directly related to the LRV

blocks.zh: 再循環溶劑的合理性（Recirculation Justification）：若使用循環沖洗水，必須驗證循環不會導致內毒素累積或再汙染
blocks.en: Recirculation Justification: if recirculated rinse water is used, it must be demonstrated that recirculation does not cause endotoxin accumulation or recontamination

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 一個 CDMO 的橡膠塞清洗驗證（Stopper Washing Validation）計畫書需要根據 USP 〈1228.4〉 建立。
blocks.en: A CDMO's stopper washing validation protocol needs to be built on USP <1228.4>.

blocks.zh: 五項 CPP 的對應設計：
blocks.en: Design corresponding to the five CPPs:

blocks.zh: 溶劑：WFI（來自本廠 WFI 系統，EC 標準 <0.25 EU/mL）+ 最終沖洗不含清潔劑
blocks.en: Solvent: WFI (from the site WFI system, acceptance standard <0.25 EU/mL) + final rinse without detergent

blocks.zh: 溫度：最終沖洗 WFI ≥80°C（高於 60°C 建議，額外安全邊際）
blocks.en: Temperature: final rinse WFI ≥80°C (above the 60°C recommendation, for an added safety margin)

blocks.zh: 壓力：洗塞機的噴水壓力 [X] bar，確保塞子各個表面都能被有效沖洗
blocks.en: Pressure: stopper washer spray pressure [X] bar, ensuring that all stopper surfaces are effectively rinsed

blocks.zh: 流速：每公斤橡膠塞的 WFI 用量 ≥[X] L，確保足夠的稀釋效果
blocks.en: Flow rate: WFI volume per kg of stoppers ≥[X] L, ensuring sufficient dilution

blocks.zh: 再循環：本計畫不使用再循環水（每次取新鮮 WFI），無需再循環合理性說明
blocks.en: Recirculation: this protocol does not use recirculated water (fresh WFI is drawn each time), so no recirculation justification is needed

blocks.zh: 為什麼 USP 特別強調 WFI 的溫度管理，而不僅僅要求使用符合規格的 WFI？這反映了什麼樣的微生物學原理？
blocks.en: Why does USP specifically emphasize WFI temperature management, rather than simply requiring WFI that meets specification? What microbiological principle does this reflect?

blocks.zh: 如果工廠使用苛性鹼（NaOH 溶液）作為清潔劑進行沖洗除熱原，驗證中必須額外測試什麼？為什麼？
blocks.en: If a site uses caustic (NaOH solution) as the detergent for depyrogenation rinsing, what additional testing is required in validation, and why?

blocks.zh: 沖洗除熱原的機制是「移除 + 稀釋」。這意味著最終的除熱原效果取決於哪些變數？
blocks.en: The mechanism of depyrogenation by rinsing is "removal + dilution". Which variables therefore determine the final depyrogenation effect?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 沖洗除熱原是熱敏感材料（橡膠塞、塑膠、醫療器材）的首選除熱原方式，機制為「物理移除 + 稀釋」
blocks.en: Depyrogenation by rinsing is the preferred method for heat-labile materials (rubber stoppers, plastics, medical devices); its mechanism is "physical removal + dilution"

blocks.zh: 沖洗水必須使用 WFI（<0.25 EU/mL），且建議在 ≥60°C 下操作，以維持微生物控制
blocks.en: Rinse water must be WFI (<0.25 EU/mL), and operation at ≥60°C is recommended to maintain microbial control

blocks.zh: 再熱原化（Re-pyrogenation）是沖洗法的最大隱性風險——受微生物汙染的 WFI 可能將內毒素沉積到已清潔的物品上
blocks.en: Re-pyrogenation is the biggest hidden risk of rinsing: microbially contaminated WFI may deposit endotoxin onto items that have already been cleaned

blocks.zh: WFI 在 8°C–55°C 的危險溫度帶中不應持水超過 3–4 小時，此為製程設計的硬性約束
blocks.en: WFI should not be held for more than 3–4 hours in the 8°C–55°C danger zone; this is a hard constraint on process design

blocks.zh: USP 要求驗證中必須定義並控制五項關鍵製程參數：溶劑描述、溫度、壓力、流速、再循環合理性
blocks.en: USP requires that five critical process parameters be defined and controlled in validation: solvent description, temperature, pressure, flow rate and recirculation justification
